design_philosophy: Archetype 5 (Luxury) mixed with Archetype 4 (Swiss/High-Contrast). The platform should feel premium, trustworthy, and highly functional. Emphasize crisp typography, stark contrasts (Dark Sidebar vs Light Content), and most critically: A GENEROUS AND PROMINENT LOGO SPACE.

typography.notes: Use strict tight tracking (`tracking-tight`) for large headings. No generic rounded fonts.

logo_requirements.CRITICAL_INSTRUCTION: The user explicitly complained about small logos in the past. You MUST provide a large, well-padded container for the logo.
logo_requirements.login_page:
Use a generous container: `h-24 w-auto` or larger. Example: `
LOGO IMOBILIÁRIA
`
logo_requirements.sidebar:
Allocate a substantial header area. Example: `
LOGO
`

layouts.login: Split screen layout. Left side: Massive high-quality architectural image covering the entire half. Right side: Centered login form, massive logo at the top, elegant minimal inputs, large button (`h-12`).
layouts.dashboard_shell: CSS Grid or Flex layout. Fixed Sidebar (`w-72 bg-stone-950`). Main content area (`flex-1 bg-stone-50`). Top header in main area for breadcrumbs and User Avatar/Menu.
layouts.user_management: A clean, card-less Table view. Do not trap the table in a small card. Let the table span full width of its container with `border-y border-stone-200`. Use Shadcn Table. Include a Header section with 'Gestão de Usuários' and a 'Adicionar Usuário' button.

component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (`rounded-md`). Large click targets (`h-10` or `h-12`). High contrast.
component_instructions.inputs: Clean, `bg-white`, 1px solid border (`border-stone-300`), focus state must be `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-stone-900`. Use standard Shadcn Form setup.
component_instructions.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for the 'Criar/Editar Usuário' form. Ensure the dialog is wide enough (`max-w-2xl`) and has generous padding (`p-8`).
component_instructions.table: Shadcn Table. Left align all text. Actions column on the right with a Shadcn DropdownMenu (Editar, Desativar).
component_instructions.avatar_menu: Shadcn DropdownMenu triggered by Shadcn Avatar in the top right of the dashboard shell.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use crisp 1px borders instead of heavy shadows to separate sections.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing. Use `p-8` or `p-12` in main content areas.
visual_enhancers.interactions: All interactive elements (rows, buttons) must have subtle `transition-colors duration-200`.

login_background.description: High-end modern luxury real estate exterior with overcast sky.

user_avatar_placeholder.description: Professional real estate broker in suit.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. The dark sidebar with light text ensures excellent readability.
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY: Add `data-testid` to ALL interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid="login-email-input"`, `data-testid="add-user-button"`, `data-testid="user-role-select"`).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST use Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) for ALL text, labels, placeholders, and error messages.
Do NOT create generic centered layouts. Use intentional grid/flex spacing.
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
Create depth through 1px borders and very subtle shadows, relying primarily on contrast.
Do NOT use placeholder.com or dummyimage. Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs.
NEVER use emojis as icons. Use Lucide React icons.
Shadcn components have opinionated rules, customize them using Tailwind classes to match this Luxury/Swiss theme.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Focus heavily on the 'Logomarca' constraints. Ensure the logo area is distinct, large, and easily replaceable by the user in the future.
